ruleDefinitions.name: CurrentControlSet Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Terminal\\ Server\\\\WinStations\\\\RDP\\-Tcp\\\\InitialProgram.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Terminal\\ Server\\\\Wds\\\\rdpwd\\\\StartupPrograms.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SecurityProviders\\\\SecurityProviders.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SafeBoot\\\\AlternateShell.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Print\\\\Providers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Print\\\\Monitors.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\NetworkProvider\\\\Order.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Lsa\\\\Notification\\ Packages.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Lsa\\\\Authentication\\ Packages.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\BootVerificationProgram\\\\ImagePath.*"))) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)" OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Print\\\\Monitors\\\\CutePDF\\ Writer\\ Monitor.*") AND (Details = "cpwmon64\_v40\.dll" OR Details = "CutePDF\ Writer")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*Print\\\\Monitors\\\\Appmon\\\\Ports\\\\Microsoft\\\.Office\\\.OneNote\\_.*") AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*"))) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\poqexec\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\NetworkProvider\\\\Order\\\\ProviderOrder$")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Print\\\\Monitors\\\\MONVNC\\\\Driver$") AND Details = "VNCpm\.dll"))
